responsibility: Defines global compiler state and configuration for the D front end. It centralizes command-line and output options (`Param`, `Output`), target-independent global bookkeeping (`Global`), file-location formatting (`Loc`), common enums for diagnostics, linkage, mangling, checking, and feature toggles, as well as shared scalar typedefs, so all front-end stages can read consistent compilation settings and update global error/reporting state.
